checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fund_master WHERE TRY_CAST(fd_nast_suma AS DOUBLE) >= 100000000000

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fund_master WHERE TRY_CAST(fd_nast_suma AS DOUBLE) >= 100000000000

checks.name: KOSDAQ150 레버리지 순자산 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND (coalesce(cu_base_index, ref_base_index) ILIKE '%KOSDAQ%150%' OR pd_nm ILIKE '%KOSDAQ%150%' OR pd_abrv_nm ILIKE '%KOSDAQ%150%') AND (pd_nm ILIKE '%레버리지%' OR pd_abrv_nm ILIKE '%레버리지%') ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: 상장중 ETF 순자산 평균(억원 단위)
checks.sql: SELECT round(avg(TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE))/1e8) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_listing_status='active' AND drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE),0) <> 0

checks.name: 삼성 상장중 ETF 순자산 평균(억원)
checks.sql: SELECT round(avg(TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE))/1e8) FROM kr_etp e LEFT JOIN mgmt_resolved m USING (pd_itm_no) WHERE drv_listing_status='active' AND drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE),0) <> 0 AND (coalesce(m.resolved, e.cu_fund_mgmt_co) = '삼성' OR coalesce(m.resolved, e.cu_fund_mgmt_co) LIKE '삼성%')
